strings.name: Anand Mahindra
strings.role: Mahindra Group chairman and industrial business leader
strings.summary: Mahindra studied film at Harvard before earning an MBA and entering his family's industrial business. He went on to lead a group spanning vehicles, farm equipment and IT. He helped advance products such as Scorpio and expansion across sectors, emphasizing a federated structure and leadership development, and initiated the Nanhi Kali girls' education project.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads the Mahindra Group, developing vehicles, farm equipment and diversified industry while supporting social enterprise.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Graduated from Harvard College in 1977 after studying film; earned an MBA from Harvard Business School in 1981.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Products and business expansion
strings.highlights.h1.text: Helped advance investment in Scorpio and diversification from group leadership roles. Tech Mahindra's Satyam acquisition and the group's later EV plans reflect transformation across operating teams.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Institutions and social investment
strings.highlights.h2.text: Emphasizes a decentralized, federated business model and internal leadership development. He also initiated Nanhi Kali to support disadvantaged girls' education.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discussed creativity and group management
strings.timeline.t1.text: In an interview published by McKinsey, discussed how film education shaped his leadership, the federated structure, Scorpio investment risks and management development.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Group launched new electric SUVs
strings.timeline.t2.text: Mahindra's teams introduced the BE 6e and XEV 9e, advancing the group's EV strategy through the work of its engineering, design and business teams.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Moved to non-executive chairman
strings.timeline.t3.text: Transitioned from executive chairman to non-executive chairman of Mahindra & Mahindra, continuing to advise management on strategy, risk and the brand, effective 12 November 2021.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Became group chairman
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became chairman and managing director of Mahindra & Mahindra and chairman of the group, continuing its development across vehicles, farm machinery and other industries.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Group expanded its IT business
strings.timeline.t5.text: Tech Mahindra, part of the group, acquired a controlling interest in Satyam through a subsidiary, bringing the scandal-hit IT services company into a process of rebuilding and integration.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Scorpio reached the market
strings.timeline.t6.text: The group launched the Scorpio SUV. He later recalled the development risk involved and the risk buffers and exit options considered in advance.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Became managing director of the flagship
strings.timeline.t7.text: Took over as managing director of Mahindra & Mahindra, assuming operational leadership of the flagship company; added the vice-chairman role in 2001.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered industry after his MBA
strings.timeline.t8.text: Returned to India after Harvard Business School and joined Mahindra Ugine Steel as executive assistant to the finance director, beginning his business career in steel.
